cross_verification.note_en: Confirmed directly from the official Vietnam National Electronic Visa system (evisa.gov.vn, Ministry of Public Security / Immigration Department), 'Instruction' page, Step 1 of the e-visa declaration guide: "the visa applicant's photo must be a recent 4x6 cm image in JPG or JPEG format, with a file size of less than 2MB. The photo should be a front-facing image with no hat, no glasses, in formal attire, and with a white background." Size (4×6cm) and background (white) both match the DB exactly — no conflict. Note the file format differs from vn-passport's domestic portal, which specifies JPEG 2000 rather than plain JPG/JPEG — the two are separate government systems (Immigration Dept. e-visa portal vs. Ministry of Public Security public-service portal) with independently published specs, not assumed to be identical.
